Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Do not waste time on custom domains, SSL certificates, or email marketing integrations. These are secondary. Focus on the core: hosting, payment verification, and product delivery. Skip SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration unless you’re selling high-volume. Avoid over-engineering the backend—Google Apps Script is sufficient for 90% of use cases. Do not attempt to build a custom dashboard; use Google Sheets for order tracking. The goal is to get your first transaction live, not to build a perfect system. Perfection is the enemy of deployment. Move fast, test, and iterate later.
The blockchain has no map of restricted countries — a wallet in Harare processes identically to one in Hamburg.

If the flow works, repeat for two more products. Document any errors and resolve them immediately. Once all three products are live and tested, your store is ready for public sales. Share the GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages URL with your audience. You are now selling globally, without geographic or platform restrictions.
